Calcutta High Court halts demolition of Abhishek Banerjee's office

The Calcutta High Court has ordered an immediate halt to the demolition of Trinamool Congress MP Abhishek Banerjee's five-storey office building in South 24 Parganas, West Bengal. The court has instructed that the status quo be maintained until the next hearing. This action follows a petition filed by Banerjee against the demolition, with the court also seeking reports on cases and FIRs against him.
